decision: Retain disabled. Stop this round of endpoint-cell/score patch candidates. No formal behavior trial or PPO.
reasons: Persistent current-hit veto works, but exact gridline observations lose occupied recall.
Closed-cell ambiguity cannot supply an obstacle normal or a range/pose uncertainty bound.
Prescribed persistent +2mm bias still gives false_free_ratio=0.04.
Local integrate cost grows; no measured task/ENV benefit supports spending engineering budget.
not_claimed: All sensor-only mapping or RL is impossible.
A future behavior trial must fail.
All ambiguous cells become unknown: previous positive evidence is retained.
Every cell in a scan has no false-free: veto only covers the current hit candidates.
next: First review/reuse the existing slam_toolbox/Karto measurement-to-map model with explicit own-estimated-pose, lattice/origin, beam counting, min/max and uncertainty assumptions. No threshold V4, truth filling or relaxed quality gates. Decide a finite CPU interface prototype before any fresh integrated behavior scope.
